turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got room for exactly one fruit tree and I keep changing my mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's an apple on a dwarf rootstock, so it stays small and fruits in a couple of years.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a fig trained against the south wall, which would love the warmth there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A plum is another one, but I've heard they crop like mad one year and then hardly at all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And maybe a cherry, though the birds would probably get most of them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Which fruit do you actually eat most? If it's apples, go dwarf apple and you'll never regret it. If you want something a bit special, the fig against the south wall is a treat that most neighbours won't have.
